Create a Volcano Plot for ORA Results

Source: R/utils_bulk.R
bulk_utils_ora_volcano_plot.Rd

Generates a volcano plot for pathway enrichment results from ORA, showing log2 fold change vs. -log10(FDR).

Usage

bulk_utils_ora_volcano_plot(
  ORA_results,
  pval.threshold = 0.05,
  selectedPathways
)

Arguments

ORA_results

Data frame of ORA results (from bulk_utils_execute_ora or bulk_utils_run_ORA).

pval.threshold

FDR threshold for significance (default: 0.05).

selectedPathways

Character vector of pathway names to label in the plot.

Value

List with elements: 'volcano' (ggplot object) and 'data' (data frame used for plotting).

Details

Used internally by the ORA Shiny panel. Significant pathways are colored red, others gray.
